from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
import os

router = APIRouter(prefix="/models/checkpoints")

@router.get("/{checkpoint_id}/download")
async def download_ray_model_checkpoint(
    checkpoint_id: str,
    meta_db: CheckpointDatabase = Depends(get_checkpoint_db),
    checkpoints_dir: str = Depends(get_checkpoints_root_dir),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    ckpt = await meta_db.get_checkpoint(checkpoint_id)
    if not ckpt or ckpt.tenant_id != current_user.tenant_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Model checkpoint not found")

    checkpoint_path = os.path.join(checkpoints_dir, checkpoint_id, "adapter_model.safetensors")
    if not os.path.exists(checkpoint_path):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Model weights file missing on disk")

    return FileResponse(
        path=checkpoint_path,
        filename=f"{checkpoint_id}_weights.safetensors",
        media_type="application/octet-stream"
    )
